meta.title: Thank You! Your Doctor24 Request Was Received
meta.description: We've received your Doctor24 benefit request with D4U Immigration. Our team will reach out shortly with the next steps.
meta.ogTitle: Thank You! Your Doctor24 Request Was Received

body:
Back to site

We've received your request!

Thank you for taking this step with D4U Immigration. Your request for 6 months of free access to Doctor24 was received successfully.

Our team will reach out shortly to confirm your details and activate access to the platform for you and your dependents.

Next steps

What happens now?

  1. 01Our team will contact you by phone, email, or WhatsApp.
  2. 02You confirm your details and the dependents included in the benefit.
  3. 03You'll receive access to the Doctor24 platform by email, valid for 6 months.

*Benefit valid for new D4U contracts, for the primary applicant and dependents included in the process. The Doctor24 platform subscription is free for the first 6 months. Medical consultations are billed separately and rates are set by participating physicians. Benefit subject to Doctor24's terms of use.
